pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions present as irregular polygons and rounded quadrilaterals. Edge gradients are smooth due to image resolution, lacking sharp pixel transitions. Patch area is larger on the neck and upper flank, decreasing significantly in scale on the lower flank and limb transition area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned negative space forms a continuous network. Topological nodes are primarily tri-radial junctions. Pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness throughout the visible flank, though boundary edges are blurred.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the upper neck and dorsal ridge displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged profile against the background, though specific individual hair clusters are not clearly resolvable due to resolution.
